title: 第二座神坛
text:
又一座神坛。你现在是第 {faith_tier} 阶，信力 {faith_points}。

到第二阶（信力 {faith_threshold:brute:2}），神坛上多两个特殊操作：「祈求赐福」花 {faith_perk:brute:altar_bless:cost} 祈愿（打完仗、献祭都会攒，花了不掉阶），把一件东西换成{faith:brute}赐福的版本；「献祭生命上限」每次扣 {faith_perk:brute:altar_sacrifice_hp:hp_cost} 点生命上限，换 {faith_perk:brute:altar_sacrifice_hp:faith_gain} 信力，或者换这局造成伤害 +{faith_perk:brute:altar_sacrifice_hp:damage_percent}%、急速 +{faith_perk:brute:altar_sacrifice_hp:haste_percent}%，每次自己挑。还没到第二阶就只有献祭，特殊操作等阶到了才会出来。

{b}只能选一个{/b}：选了，这座神坛就关了，献祭也不能再做 —— 这就是二选一。

texts.en:
Another altar. You're at Rank {faith_tier} with {faith_points} Faith.

At Rank two ({faith_threshold:brute:2} Faith) the altar adds two special actions. "Ask for a blessing" costs {faith_perk:brute:altar_bless:cost} Prayer (earned from battles and Offerings; spending it never lowers your Rank) and turns one item into a version blessed by {faith:brute}. "Offer your max Health" takes {faith_perk:brute:altar_sacrifice_hp:hp_cost} max Health each time, in exchange for {faith_perk:brute:altar_sacrifice_hp:faith_gain} Faith, or for +{faith_perk:brute:altar_sacrifice_hp:damage_percent}% damage dealt and +{faith_perk:brute:altar_sacrifice_hp:haste_percent}% Haste for this run. You choose each time. Below Rank two there's only the Offering; the special actions appear once your Rank allows.

{b}You get one.{/b} Pick it and this altar closes, and no more Offerings either. That's what pick one means.

options.label: 献祭或特殊操作，二选一

labels.en: Offering or special action, pick one
